1001 Crosswords.name: 1001 Crosswords
1001 Crosswords.summary: Full of teasing crosswords from the UK’s leading national newspapers, this new collection contains an incredible 1001 puzzles of all levels of difficulty; enough for even the most determined crossword fanatic to get their teeth in to. Featuring a combination of Quick and Cryptic crosswords, 1001 Crosswords offers something for everyone. Take the hot seat and challenge a friend in a timed crossword duel! Use the inbuilt keyboard or write your own letters using the stylus. And if you’re really stuck, why not try the Hint button? But watch out for the time penalty! Everyone from the keenest puzzle fan to novices will find puzzles that challenge, confound and enlighten. So snuggle up on the sofa, turn off the phone, put the kettle on and get ready to dive into the biggest collection of crosswords that has ever been published on Nintendo DS!

Aliens in the Attic.name: Aliens in the Attic
Aliens in the Attic.summary: Aliens in the Attics for the Wii, PlayStation 2 and PC versions give players a whole new way to experience the story by assuming the identity of different alien explorers whose motives are to rid of the house guests so they can take over the mansion and possibly the world. Players will experience 15 exciting levels, four locations, and switch between players for fast paced action.

Cats & Dogs - The Revenge of Kitty Galor.name: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
Cats & Dogs - The Revenge of Kitty Galor.summary: In Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore, players fight Kitty Galore's agents of evil to save the day and send the bad guys packing. Players will have to utilize their animalistic acrobatics and AI "Animal Intelligence" to make their way through various levels and obstacles and collect critical items and power-ups, which will unlock new areas as they progress through the game. They will also be challenged by a number of covert missions including helping stool pigeons carry out their air-based special operations and destroying Kitty Galore's treacherous equipment. Featuring six different mission types, including escort, stealth and combat, the game promises to deliver on all the excitement of the film, leading to the big showdown with Kitty Galore.

Kouenji Joshi Soccer 2 - Koi wa Nebagiba.name: Kouenji Joshi Soccer 2: Koi wa Nebagiba Kouenji
Kouenji Joshi Soccer 2 - Koi wa Nebagiba.summary: Kouenji Joshi Soccer 2: Koi wa Nebagiba Kouenji is an Adventure game, developed and published by Starfish SD, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Layton Kyouju to Akuma no Hako - Friendl.name: Professor Layton and the Diabolical Box
Layton Kyouju to Akuma no Hako - Friendl.summary: Professor Layton may be a world-famous sleuth, but even he will need your assistance to crack these challenging puzzles. With Nintendo DS stylus in hand, it's time to muster up some mental might!

Littlest Pet Shop - City Friends.name: Littlest Pet Shop: City Friends
Littlest Pet Shop - City Friends.summary:
It's time to hit the town! Explore new worlds, customize accessories, and enjoy awesome mini-games, and collect six exclusive city pets with The Littlest Pet City Friends!

The Littlest Pet Shop: Friends series brings the party to you with a new cast of quirky pets and their best friends. Play tons of new mini-games and explore new towns with your favorite pets.

With enhanced multiplayer features, you can even double your fun by playing with your best friend! Venture on quests, deliver invitations, serve up ice cream, and style your pets as you get ready for the biggest Littlest Pet Shop party of the year. And be prepared for a few surprises along the way, like an all-new mystery pet that just might show up at your party!

Pop Town.name: Pop Town
Pop Town.summary: Sequel for Kira Kira Pop Princess.

Puzzle Expedition.name: Puzzle Expedition
Puzzle Expedition.summary: Puzzle Expedition is unique puzzle game which focuses on the cooperation of two characters, Anna and Ben, who help each other to get out of the labyrinth. Help them to succeed in their quest!

Quest Trio, The - Jewels, Cards and Tile.name: The Quest Trio
Quest Trio, The - Jewels, Cards and Tile.summary: The Quest Trio is a puzzle game compilation featuring three distinct matching experiences across African and Asian settings. Players follow Rupert Pack's search for a legendary jewel board while engaging in jewel-matching, mahjong tile arrangements, and solitaire card challenges. The collection includes Jewel Quest Expeditions, Jewel Quest Solitaire, and Mah Jong Quest: Expeditions, offering varied puzzle mechanics that combine exploration themes with traditional matching gameplay. Each game mode presents different objectives, from restoring world balance through tile matching to pursuing fortune through card-based adventures.

Simple DS Series Vol. 44 - The Gal Mahjo.name: Simple DS Series Vol. 44: The Gal Mahjong
Simple DS Series Vol. 44 - The Gal Mahjo.summary: Simple DS Series Vol. 44 - The Gal Mahjong is a mahjong game in which the player takes the role of a high school student that will try to win the heart of one of the 8 girls that the game features. It is part of the Simple DS series.

Zorro - Quest for Justice.name: Zorro: Quest for Justice
Zorro - Quest for Justice.summary: The swordsman returns again for a bout on the DS.
